examples.title: Advertise a Tool Example
examples.description: We fully automate your ad display based on our algorithms to ensure that you can get no less than the number of clicks purchased, but we cannot guarantee the quality of the clicks.
examples.note: Your ad budget is prioritized to generate clicks and impressions as quickly as possible. You have full control to pause or resume your ads at any time.
examples.typesTitle: Here are a few types of ads:
examples.standardDesc: Appears on the home page, listings, and category pages.
examples.effectiveDesc: Appears on your competitors' pages, and in the category pages you belong to.
examples.featuredDesc1: Featured placement on the Homepage, Latest AI, Most Used, Most Saved, Search Results, and Category pages.
examples.featuredDesc2: Sponsored positions appear at the top of most pages.

items.question: How does advertising work?
items.answer: We display your tool in premium positions across our platform. You pay per click, and we ensure your ad gets the number of clicks you purchased.

items.question: Can I purchase clicks multiple times?
items.answer: Yes, you can purchase additional click packages at any time to boost your tool's visibility.

items.question: Can I pause my ads?
items.answer: Yes, you can pause and resume your ad campaigns at any time from your dashboard.

items.question: What kind of analytics do I get?
items.answer: You'll receive detailed data on organic clicks, paid clicks, total clicks, impressions, and saves.
